description: This file defines the AssetRepository class, responsible for CRUD operations and querying assets in a PostgreSQL database within a .NET project. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and querying asset data, with emphasis on handling soft deletes and filtered searches.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD operations for assets, including methods for creating, fetching by ID, updating, and querying assets with filters.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database and returns the created AssetDto.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by its ID, excluding soft-deleted entries.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset identified by assetId with new data, returning the updated AssetDto.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of assets based on optional filter parameters, excluding soft-deleted entries.
